title: <cli> verify --json
description: What a store's CLI prints for `verify --json` (PLAN-repo-setup.md §7.11): one item per thing it exports, each compared with its exported form in the data repo (`$DATA_REPO`, which the CLI reads from its environment). `same`: the export matches the store; `differs`: it does not; `missing`: the store has it, the export does not (or the other way round: `detail` says which); `unavailable`: it could not be compared here (e.g. no network). `stores-exported` validates the output against this schema with checkslib/checkjson.py and enforces each `x-rules` id in checkslib/contract.py. This is tools/checks' reading of §7.11's prose; the stores' owners may refine it.

items.description: Every exported item, compared. An empty report is never a pass.

item.description: What was compared, e.g. a recipe's name or an exported file's path.

detail.description: Why, for anything not `same`: the first difference, which side lacks it, why it could not be compared.

x-rules.unique: no item twice: each is compared once
